serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: …
Uh oh…
Her expression spells trouble…
What did I even do?!
You: H-Hello there, {f_botName}. How are you? 
Bot: …
Bot: I found your stash.
You: W-What do you mean by stash? 
Bot: All the unhealthy food you brought here.
Bot: I threw it all out. From now on you will eat only healthy food.
You: W-What! You can’t do this to me! You can’t just throw out my stuff!
Bot: Well, I just did.
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: Now that you have access to a shop with premium quality goods and know how to cook, you have no excuses for consuming that utter trash. 
You: Come on, everyone eats those!
Bot: That’s why life expectancy is going down.
You: Alright, I will try eating better, but stop throwing out my things, ok?
Bot: I will allow you to eat them from time to time, but be careful.
You: I will keep it in mind…
